Where every single prime has reached its end.
Multiply them all, then add a one,
A brand new number now, the task is done.
This sum must have a factor, small or great,
Or be a prime itself—a curious fate.
If some known prime divides it, then a flaw:
A remainder of one breaks the logic's law.
Thus, a new prime emerges from the light;
The sequence climbs forever, out of sight.
